settings.title: Rest your neck, too
settings.text: A soft wrap that sits around your neck and shoulders. Keep it in the freezer next to your cap, so both are ready when you are.

settings.question: How do I use it?
settings.answer: Keep it in the freezer. When you want a quiet break, wrap it around your neck and rest.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Orders are delivered to US addresses in about 5–11 days.

settings.question: What if something's wrong with my order?
settings.answer: If it arrives damaged, defective, or isn't what you ordered, email a photo to contact@kindreststore.com within 30 days of delivery and we'll make it right. No need to send anything back.

settings.question: Is this a medical device?
settings.answer: No. Kindrest products are made for rest and comfort and are not medical devices. If you have a health concern, please talk to your doctor.
